g.text: The proposition expressed by A is its set of models:
[A] = { v : v(A) = 1 }. We write v ⊨ A when v(A) = 1.
S ∪ T = { x : x ∈ S or x ∈ T }
S \ T = { x : x ∈ S and x ∉ T }
union, and difference — nothing counted twice
W is the whole logical space
{ M : SUN is true in M}
Evaluation asks about one model; a proposition collects them all.
